verdict.instructions: Does the page support the claim?

criteria.supports: The page states what the claim says.
criteria.partly: The page supports part of the claim; the rest is not on the page.
criteria.not_supported: The page does not say what the claim says, and does not say the opposite.
criteria.contradicts: The page says the opposite of the claim, or gives different figures.
criteria.unreadable: The page has no usable text: a paywall, a cookie wall or an empty shell.

supports.instructions: Does the page support everything the claim says?

criteria.true: Every part of the claim is stated on the page.
criteria.false: Some part of the claim is missing from the page or contradicted by it.
